title: Ed R. Levin Hang-gliding and Paragliding Landing Zone

services.name: Tandem flights
services.desc: Tandem flights are strongly discouraged at Windy Hill due to the long glide to the LZ, frequent challenging flying conditions, and limited size of the LZ. Tandem flights are only permitted with the explicit permission of the Windy Hill Site
